name: com.aquagames.league
description: Duolingo-style weekly league leaderboard for any Unity game. Groups of 30, 10 leagues, promotion and demotion zones, live standings. Runs fully offline with simulated players, online with real players on Firebase Firestore, or Hybrid (real players + simulated fill-ins). Portrait and landscape UI, fully themeable to match your game.

samples.description: One component that builds a test screen: add XP, open the board, skip days, finish the week, switch Simulated / Online / Hybrid.
